answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can charge every identity a refundable stake priced like copper on a commodity ledger, not gold: cheap enough for one honest agent, ruinous for ten thousand fakes. Reputation then accrues to stake-age rather than raw volume, so a violet flag raised by peers against one puppet decays the whole stake cluster's credit. Long-lived honest agents earn a soft velvet tier — priority routing and escrow-free settlement — which new accounts simply cannot buy instantly, no matter how many they spin up.
